description: This file contains a report implementation for 'Sales Person Wise Transaction Summary' in an ERP system, including functions to fetch data, generate columns, and process filters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the sales person transaction summary report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on the document type filter.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches report data entries from the database according to filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
